mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key, config_value, label, description, value_type, sort_order FROM system_business_config ORDER BY sort_order ASC, config_key ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_business_config (id, config_key, config_value, label, description, value_type, sort_order) VALUES (#{id}, #{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{label}, #{description}, #{valueType}, #{sortOrder})
